The brief

NOVARA is a spec ad for a fictional Milan espresso brand, made entirely in ComfyUI on a 10 GB GPU. The point is the pipeline: a brief goes in, and every stage that usually breaks AI advertising (the customer changing face between shots, the logo melting, a weak shot slipping through) has a node that catches it.

What I did

  • Designed the pipeline end to end, brief to finished MP4.
  • Keyframes: generated the first shot, then edited each later shot from the previous one with Qwen Image Edit and a next-scene LoRA, so the same customer appears in every shot.
  • Built the Shot Critic: Gemini reviews every shot three times and takes a majority vote, then routes it.
  • Used Detail Fixer to repair the logo only on flagged shots, with a keep-better gate.
  • Made image-to-video switchable per shot: local Wan, local MiniMax H3, or API models such as Kling.
